title: Athenia says 最大66万3,481件 customer records may have leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: 26 November is the day Athenia announced the leak, per Cybersecurity.com (Japan); the page gives no earlier disclosure day.
geo_basis: Japan, as the company and publisher are Japanese; no city stated in the source read
summary: Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reports that Athenia announced on 26 November that 最大66万3,481件 customer records may have been affected after unauthorized access to Plaid's KARTE. The article says the data was a sequence ID, gender and date of birth, and that names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, passwords and card data were not included. No misuse had been confirmed as of 26 November, per the article.
plain: Athenia says 最大66万3,481件 customer records may have leaked from vendor Plaid's KARTE service. They hold an internal ID, gender and birth date, not names or card data.
exec: Athenia says 最大66万3,481件 records may have been affected through a vendor's marketing tool; no misuse confirmed as of 26 November.
action: As Athenia urges, be alert to fake emails or SMS messages impersonating Athenia, do not open suspicious links and always log in through the official website.

evidence.quote: 対象は最大66万3,481件で、利用終了から約7年半が過ぎたデータがKARTE上に残っていた点が注目される。

validation.note: Only Cybersecurity.com (Japan) read; it relays Athenia's 26 November announcement. Athenia's PDF notice could not be read (binary).
